title: Here is my rougelike game ive been making with claude.
author: Admirable_Leave7840
selftext:
Hey guys , have a look at my rougelike game ive been busy making with claude over the past few months , ive been having so much fun making tuning and tweaking this game , give it a try and let me know what you think.

The code is python, prompted through claude, mainly opus but sometimes sonnet for the easy things, used fable when it came out to proof ready, check and suggest changes. Confirm UI was used for almost all the assets, as its got a few good nodes and tools for sprite generation, also fast too, I use it locally on my pc at home, takes about 30sec per sprite.

Ive attached Google play codes below for those wanting to try it out, if codes run out , I have plenty more.
